Pin the Nix flake and direnv development environment

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Pin nixpkgs revision/NAR hash and use one Python 3.11/tool declaration on Linux/macOS.
- [ ] Keep Python wheel and non-Nix installation independent of Nix/direnv.
- [ ] Pass static Nix/Bash/YAML checks and post-change source/build/clean-install verification.
- [ ] Run unchanged-lock nix flake check and Nix environment acceptance on Linux/macOS.
- [ ] Review .envrc and verify direnv entry/exit after explicit host trust authorization.
- [ ] Apply the version-1 delta without losing mini validation, skill installation or Issue links.

Version impact: none: developer tooling; candidate stays 1.0.0, immutable work tag after actual completion.

Evidence: docs/project/nix-development.md and validation.md. Cloud has no Nix/direnv; do not close this unit until execution acceptance is recorded.
